map.管理药品批号与效期，自动按剩余天数分级预警（近效期/临期/过期），数据保存在本地: Manage drug lot numbers and expiry, auto-grade alerts by remaining days (near-expiry/urgent-expiry/expired); data is saved in the local browser.
map.家庭或药房批量登记药品批号与有效期至，工具按当前日期自动计算剩余天数并分级（正常: Households or pharmacies batch-register drug lot numbers and expiry dates; the tool auto-computes remaining days by current date and grades them (normal / near-expiry / urgent-expiry / expired).
map.自定义预警阈值（如近效期 180 天、临期紧急 30 天），适配不同管理粒度。: Custom alert thresholds (e.g., near-expiry 180 days, urgent-expiry 30 days) to fit different management granularities.
map.数据保存在本地浏览器，便于随时增删改与盘点，过期药品及时清理避免误用。: Data is saved in the local browser for easy add/edit/delete and inventory; clear expired drugs promptly to avoid misuse.
map.：剩余天数 = 111 天；默认阈值下 111 ≤ 180 → 近效期（建议优先: : remaining days = 111 days; under default thresholds 111 <= 180 -> near-expiry (recommended to use first). Examples: 200 days left -> normal, 100 days -> near-expiry, 20 days -> urgent-expiry, -5 days -> expired.
map.近效期和临期紧急怎么区分？: How to distinguish near-expiry and urgent-expiry?
map.默认近效期阈值为 180 天（剩余 ≤180 天提示尽早使用），临期紧急阈值为: Default near-expiry threshold is 180 days (remaining <=180 days prompts early use), urgent-expiry threshold is 30 days (remaining <=30 days must be handled immediately). Thresholds are customizable on the page.
map.数据存在哪里、会丢失吗？: Where is data stored, and can it be lost?
map.数据保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，不上传服务器；更换设备或清理浏览: Data is saved in the local browser's localStorage, not uploaded to servers; changing devices or clearing browser data loses it, so back up important inventory separately.
